caption:
For what you carry that no one else can see

Allah tells us He is the Knower of the unseen and the seen, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful. What is hidden from everyone else is known to Him, so bring it to Him tonight in your dua.

Surah Al-Hashr 59:22

Call on Him by these names before you sleep tonight

#namesofallah #arrahman #surahhashr #quranreels

Recitation: Maher Al-Muaiqly
